name: followtide
title: followtide
blurb: paste a Bluesky handle and followtide sankeys everyone you currently follow onto a real time axis, bucketed by the month you followed them, "following now" at the present on the left — a Minard-style tide of your own follow history. @scoiattolo.mountainherder.xyz asked for it, @vibecode.rodeo flagged it up for a build.
